svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bought: a 6 mm spine 320 x 50 mm with 40 fins 30 mm deep at 8 mm pitch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: MOSFET holes: eight M3 tapped holes through the spine (drill 2.5),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 26.5 mm up from the bottom edge, 20 mm from the left end and then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every 40 mm, each midway between two fins. Deburr the front face flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate screws: three M3 tapped holes 10 mm deep in the bottom edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred in the spine's 6 mm thickness, 40, 160 and 280 mm from the left end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shroud screws: two M3 tapped holes 8 mm deep in each end of the spine,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred in its thickness, 15 and 35 mm up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use cutting fluid; back the tap out often; the walls are thin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the plate, fins to the back; MOSFETs on the smooth face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an M3 screw runs freely into every hole.
